narrative: The UK FP&A Director's PhoneLine+ model, rebuilt literally on Snowflake: 312k lines × GBP 11.40 unit revenue × GBP 5.47 GP per line (48%). 71% of growth is migration from Gamma's own legacy base, so each migrated line gives up GBP 7.35 of monthly GP against legacy voice. The ML forecast (92% accuracy against 80% in Excel) uses the exchange switch-off calendar as a driver.

signals.title: FP&A runs on Excel and months-old data
signals.excerpt: Forecast and variance analysis are built in Excel from MySQL and SQL Server extracts; reporting data was as old as 18 August, with manual reprocessing in FP&A and reporting.

signals.title: UK PSTN switch-off — January 2027
signals.excerpt: Exchanges moving to stop-sell accelerate legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases; customers must migrate to IP voice (PhoneLine+, Horizon, SIP) or leave.
